what: the forecasts and the rule of the reading, committed before any trained state exists

learning_rate.pilot: pool5, fold 0, 100 steps, the training curve only (results/pilot.json): the largest error of a row falls 0.82, 0.60, 0.36, 0.26, 0.27 and nothing diverges

the_judge: scripts/read.py: account.account for IRF1 on PD-L1 at V, Z, T, P0, P4, P5, PM, every cell at the state trained on the other half; a step is 0.10

hypotheses.H1: carried at P5 over Z: gain at least 0.10 and its interval above zero; refuted if the interval lies below 0.10
hypotheses.H2: carried at P5 over PM: the same rule
hypotheses.H3: carried at P4 over Z: the same rule

guards: for each of IFNGR1, IFNGR2, JAK2, STAT1: the interval of carried at P5 over Z does not lie below -0.10
the cross-validated error of a control readout at P5 is at most 1.05 times that at Z, on control cells the pooling never saw
reported_beside: carried at P5 over P0 (the same four blocks with nothing trained), and at P5 over T (the state typed by declared gene sets)

known_before.from: the rehearsal of read.py on made-up states (the mean with noise): the stages V, Z and T are the released ones

what_the_pilot_changes_in_what_the_autho: The control readout came to read the rows of the pathway events within 100 steps, and IRF1's shift went from -0.00 to -0.22 of a row of -0.40, on the cells of the fit.
